walkthrough: Goal: keep an artwork safe outside the app and bring it back; get back an earlier state after a mistake undo can no longer reach; find an artwork by its title.

Entry, files: in the gallery every card has three buttons right of its title: options (three dots), duplicate and delete. Options grows a panel out of the card, headed by the title: 'Save as OpenPaint file…' with the note '.openpaint', then 'Versions' and Close. '+' keeps its sizes and adds, under 'From a file', 'Open OpenPaint file…' with the note 'As a new artwork' (Procreate's Import).

Save: tap Save as OpenPaint file…: the panel closes and the system's save dialog suggests 'Untitled Artwork.openpaint'. Cancel: nothing happens, nothing is said. Storage full: 'Couldn't save the file.' with OK. Chosen: 'Saved as an OpenPaint file.' with OK. The file holds the artwork whole (strokes, fills, smudges, masks, groups, clipping, modes, adjustments, transforms, inserted pictures) and its title and picture; not the brushes and colours, not undo, not its versions.

Open: tap '+', then Open OpenPaint file…: the popover closes and the system's picker opens on every file. Cancel: nothing. A file that is not OpenPaint's: 'Couldn't open the file: it is not an OpenPaint file.'; a damaged one: '…: it is damaged.'; one from a newer OpenPaint: '…: it needs a newer OpenPaint.', each with OK, and nothing changes. Chosen: a new card comes first with the file's title and picture; nothing is replaced. Opened, it shows exactly the canvas that was saved.

Versions: each time I leave an artwork I changed (to the gallery, or the app goes away), the app keeps it as I left it; the newest ten per artwork stay. Options lists them newest first, each by the date and time it was kept ('5 Oct 2026 12:01'; with the seconds when two share a minute); with none yet the hint says 'Kept when you leave it after a change.'. Tap one: the panel closes and a copy titled 'Untitled Artwork (5 Oct 2026 12:01)' comes first, showing the artwork as it was then; the artwork and its versions stay as they were. To undo, delete the copy. Deleting an artwork deletes its versions (the dialog says so).

Search: the top band's middle holds a field 'Search'. Tap it and type: only cards whose title holds the text (any case) show; none: 'No title holds “…”.' Emptied, every card shows. It is not kept: after a restart every card shows.
After: imported artworks and copies are artworks like any other (rename, duplicate, delete, draw); versions and files survive a restart.
Not here: PSD and OpenRaster, sharing a file to another app, opening a .openpaint file from another app, versions of the toolbox, a picture per version.
